description: This file defines a persistent grain class for Orleans, including state management and methods for initializing and updating the grain's payload, along with logging and performance measurement.

classes.name: PersistentGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the persistent state of the grain, containing a byte array payload.

classes.name: PersistentGrain
classes.description: Grain class implementing IPersistentGrain, managing state initialization and updates with logging and performance measurement.

methods.name: PersistentGrain
methods.description: Constructor injecting logger and persistent state dependencies.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the grain's payload with sequential byte values up to payloadSize and writes the state.

methods.name: TrySet
methods.description: Attempts to read, modify, and write the grain's payload at a specified index, measuring elapsed time and logging success or failure.
